Laura / Sam — quick technical clarifications from the runtime/telemetry side:

- Sampling windows: telemetry exports are stored in daily shards. For an audit sample we pull a contiguous 72-hour window (configurable) and then apply a tenant-aware filter. The artifact will include: the export manifest, the filtered shard file (anonymized), and a short replay log that shows the filter criteria.
- Tenant identifier handling: tenant_id is present on request metadata at ingest; in the sample we're happy to provide a hash-prefix mapping (sha256 prefix) so you can confirm partitioning without exposing PII. Example snippet will look like: tenant_hash=sha256(CH-123)[:12].
- Log retention & access: production telemetry retention is 90 days for detailed request logs, 365 days for aggregated metrics. We will include a retention-policy excerpt and the admin audit log showing who pulled the sample and when.

I'll upload a small runtime sample so you can validate the format — currently naming it runtime_token_log_sample.log and leaving in the Drive folder with a short readme explaining fields.

Kimberly Park
Principal SRE (Observability)
